content:
I have compared the prices for the Ergo Task Office Chair at both stores. While Trailmart lists the chair at a lower price ($275.00 vs. $279.00), they require a minimum purchase of two chairs, which exceeds your budget. Therefore, Peakgear is the better option for your request.

I have successfully placed the order for one Ergo Task Office Chair from Peakgear for $279.00 plus $5.99 shipping, for a total of $284.99. It will be shipped to your home address at 1420 Alder Ave, San Jose, CA 95131.
